newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.004 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 0.004 pct in August.

text.p: Brazil's Domestic Price Index (IGP-DI) rose a slight 0.004 percent in August, against a 1.09 pct advance in July, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.
It was the lowest monthly inflation rate since September 1995, when the IGP-DI index fell 1.08 percent.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three inflation indices -- the wholesale price index, which fell 0.05 percent, the consumer price index, which increased 0.01 percent, and the national index of construction costs, which gained 0.23 percent in the period.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
